products.name: Kyoto Fluted Ceramic Vase Trio
products.subtitle: Hand-thrown stoneware with artisanal matte ivory glaze
products.description: Sculpted with subtle vertical fluting, this trio of vases brings architectural rhythm to coffee tables, consoles, or dining surfaces. Cast from natural clay and hand-finished with a soft, chalky reactive ivory glaze.
products.dimensions: Large: 26cm H x 14cm D | Med: 20cm H x 12cm D | Small: 14cm H x 10cm D
products.careInstructions: Wipe clean with a damp microfiber cloth. Waterproof interior allows fresh floral stems.

products.name: Aura Travertine & Linen Table Lamp
products.subtitle: Solid honed stone base with natural woven shade
products.description: Grounded by a heavy cylindrical base of honed Roman travertine, the Aura lamp produces an ambient 2700K golden glow through a bespoke textured linen drum shade. Includes brass rotary dimmer switch.
products.dimensions: Height: 46cm | Shade Diameter: 32cm | Cord: 1.8m braided textile
products.materials: Solid travertine stone, brushed solid brass hardware, Belgian linen shade
products.careInstructions: Dust shade gently with a soft brush. Seal travertine stone once yearly to protect against spills.

products.name: Solstice Heavy Slub Linen Cushion Cover
products.subtitle: French flax linen with hidden zipper and tailored flanged edge
products.description: Woven from 380 GSM heavyweight washed linen, the Solstice cushion offers unparalleled softness with rustic elegance. The tailored flange edge creates casual volume that softens structured sofas.
products.dimensions: 50cm x 50cm (Insert not included; fits 52x52cm feather insert)
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold on gentle cycle. Tumble dry low or air dry in shade. Warm iron if desired.

products.name: Verona Sculpted Marble Footed Bowl
products.subtitle: Carved from single block of white Banswara marble
products.description: An organic, fluid silhouette inspired by classical antiquity. Each Verona bowl is carved from a single piece of solid white marble with subtle natural grey and taupe veining, perched on three rounded pedestal feet.
products.materials: Solid natural Indian Banswara white marble, honed matte seal
products.careInstructions: Food safe. Hand wash with mild dish soap. Do not leave acidic liquids or citrus peels resting in bowl.

products.name: Faux Fiddle Leaf Fig in Terracotta Vessel
products.subtitle: Botanically accurate foliage with textured real-touch leaves
products.description: Enjoy enduring botanical presence without watering or sunlight constraints. Featuring 28 botanically realistic leaves with natural vein depth, potted permanently in an antiqued clay vessel with preserved faux moss.
products.materials: Polyurethane real-touch foliage, wire armature, reclaimed clay pot
products.careInstructions: Wipe leaves periodically with a dry feather duster or soft cloth to prevent dust accumulation.

products.name: Elysian Minimalist Plaster Relief Wall Art
products.subtitle: Tactile layered gypsum paste in natural oak gallery frame
products.description: Subtle shadows change gracefully throughout the day as light moves across this tactile textured plaster artwork. Hand-troweled onto archival wood board and framed in sustainable blonde Japanese oak.
products.dimensions: 80cm x 60cm x 4cm (Includes solid oak frame and pre-installed D-rings)
products.materials: Gypsum relief plaster, heavyweight backing board, solid white oak frame
products.careInstructions: Hang with provided wall anchors. Dust frame and surface lightly with clean dry paintbrush.

products.name: Nocturne Sandalwood & Amber Soy Candle
products.subtitle: Ceramic lidded jar with crackling organic wooden wick
products.description: Infuse your space with comforting grounding warmth. Opening with notes of cardamom and cedarwood, unfurling into rich smoked sandalwood and velvety amber resin. Burns clean for over 65 hours.
products.materials: 100% natural soy & coconut wax, organic wood wick, handmade stoneware vessel
products.careInstructions: Trim wood wick to 5mm before every lighting. Burn for 2-3 hours on first burn to prevent tunneling.

products.name: Wabi-Sabi Hand-Carved Mango Wood Tray
products.subtitle: Solid sustainably harvested wood with organic live-edge contours
products.description: Perfect for grouping coffee table objects, resting teacups, or styling bedside essentials. Each tray showcases distinctive grain variations, warm golden-brown undertones, and subtle artisan chisel marks.
products.materials: Sustainably sourced kiln-dried mango wood, natural beeswax seal
products.careInstructions: Wipe with soft damp cloth. Condition periodically with mineral oil or organic beeswax paste.

products.name: Astrid Brushed Brass Minimalist Table Clock
products.subtitle: Silent sweep quartz movement in solid spun brass case
products.description: An elegant counterpoint to screen fatigue. The Astrid clock features a clean dial with embossed hour batons, spun brass casing, and a whisper-silent non-ticking Japanese quartz movement.
products.materials: Solid brass with clear anti-tarnish protective lacquer, mineral glass lens
products.careInstructions: Requires 1 AA battery (included). Clean with soft lint-free cloth. Do not use chemical metal polishes.

products.name: Merino Wool Waffle Throw Blanket with Fringe
products.subtitle: Ultra-fine 19-micron pure wool in deep waffle weave
products.description: Weightless yet sumptuously warm. Crafted from ethically sourced Australian merino wool, woven into an airy dimensional honeycomb waffle structure finished with delicate twisted fringe borders.
products.careInstructions: Dry clean recommended, or hand wash gently in cold water with wool detergent. Dry flat.

products.name: Arched Minimalist Brass Wall Mirror
products.subtitle: Slender extruded brass frame with distortion-free glass
products.description: An architectural statement that amplifies light and space. Slender 8mm brass edge profile with timeless soft curved arch silhouette, providing impeccable crystal-clear reflection.
products.dimensions: 90cm Height x 60cm Width x 2.5cm Depth | Weighs 7.2kg
products.materials: Extruded brass casing, shatter-resistant silver-backed float glass
products.careInstructions: Spray glass cleaner directly onto cloth (not onto mirror surface) and buff dry with microfiber.

products.name: Cast Brass Taper Candle Holders (Pair)
products.subtitle: Substantial weighted bases with flared drip cups
products.description: Designed to elevate evening dining and mantelscapes. Solid cast brass with a gentle satin brushed luster that deepens with character over time. Accommodates standard 22mm beeswax or paraffin tapers.
products.dimensions: Tall: 24cm H | Short: 18cm H | Base: 8cm diameter
products.materials: Solid forged brass, felted underside base to protect furniture surfaces
products.careInstructions: To remove wax residue, immerse in warm water for 2 minutes and wipe clean. Polish with dry cotton.
